title: Comparative Evaluation of SDP, SOCP, and QC Convex Relaxations for Large-Scale Market-Based AC Optimal Power Flow
summary: The alternating current optimal power flow (ACOPF) problem is central to modern power system operations, determining how electricity is generated and transmitted to maximize social welfare while respecting physical and operational constraints. However, the nonlinear and non-convex nature of AC power flow equations makes finding globally optimal solutions computationally intractable for large networks.
